correctness.rationale: The repeated-pair lemma forces every third vertex on a repeated pair to have degree one, yielding a deletion recurrence. Linear families are exactly partial Steiner triple packings and are automatically 2-cover-free. Combining the recurrence with the classical exact D(v,3,2) table and checked small cases proves the formula; strict growth over two steps proves extremal linearity for v>=7.

originality.rationale: The 1982 Erdős-Frankl-Füredi source gives the general weight-three upper bound and asymptotic statement, while current CFF literature records packing-to-CFF constructions. Searches did not locate the exact all-v equality with D(v,3,2) plus the extremal-linearity theorem. Originality remains to the best of our knowledge, with explicit residual risk from incompletely inspected later sources and alternative terminology.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete exact capacity formula for constant-column-weight-three binary 2-disjunct matrices and shows every optimum from v>=7 is a classical maximum triple packing, sharpening a classical asymptotic/universal upper-bound picture into an exact structural result.
